reason: Verified QA agent can receive and respond to a message with correct mathematical answer
steps: Navigated to http://localhost:47891 — Page loaded successfully with Gamut app showing sidebar with agents list
Found and clicked "QA-20260924-165430-8bsg" agent in the sidebar — Agent detail page opened with status indicator visible
Verified agent status is "idle" — Status indicator at top of page shows "idle" which meets requirement (running or idle)
Clicked message input textbox — Textbox became active with cursor ready for input
Typed message "Hello! What is 2+2?" — Message text appeared in the input field
Clicked "Send message" button — Message was sent successfully and chat view opened showing the message with timestamp "Today at 4:55 PM"
Waited up to 3 minutes for response (Step 5) — Response arrived within seconds. Activity indicator showed "Working..." status, then agent status changed back to "idle"

Verified response mentions "4" and took screenshot (Step 6) — Agent responded with "2 + 2 = 4." which explicitly contains the number "4". Screenshot captured showing full conversation with both user message and agent response clearly visible
